# Step - set_label

`set_label` · category: [Changing the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#changing-the-graph)

Changes the label of each incoming edge and passes it on (Graphersal extension; vertices use add_label()/drop_label()).

## Forms

```text
set_label(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.e(0).set_label("met").label().next()   // met
```
